newsitem.title: CHINA: First Chicago opens Beijing branch.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago opens Beijing branch.

text.p: First Chicago NDB Corp said on Monday it had upgraded its existing representative office in the Chinese capital to a full branch bank.
First Chicago said the branch would offer trade services, remittances, onshore lending and foreign exchange translation.
First Chicago chairman Verne Istock told reporters he expected the bank to be profitable despite the increasingly crowded banking field in China.
He said the bank had already seen rising demand for trade-related services due to growing U.S.-China trade.
Other bank officials said that conducting business in China's currency, the yuan, would be a high priority in future.

However, the bank does not have a branch or representative office in Shanghai's Pudong district, which has been designated as the first area in China that will allow foreign banks to lend and collect deposits in yuan.
